Allergen practice

Peanut yogurt

Mogyoróvajas joghurt

6 months+ Adjusted 5 min 1 portion

Use the fruit purée path if milk is not yet tolerated, and then the only allergen is peanut. Try the first taste in the morning on a well day. After peanut is tolerated, offer about two teaspoons thinned, three times a week.

Best eaten fresh.

Ingredients

  • 1 tsp smooth peanut butter (no bits; never served thick on a spoon)
  • 3 tbsp plain pasteurized yogurt (milk path; unsweetened)
  • 3 tbsp fruit purée (milk-free path; use this instead of yogurt, not as well as a thick nut spoon)

Allergens

milkpeanut

Method

  1. Choose either yogurt or fruit purée.
  2. Stir one teaspoon of smooth peanut butter into three tablespoons of the chosen base.
  3. Keep stirring until no thick pocket of peanut butter remains.
  4. Thin further if the mix still holds a peak.
  5. Offer a small taste from a spoon, never the peanut butter alone.

Adjusted

A baby with severe eczema or egg allergy should be assessed before the first peanut taste. Never give a spoon of thick peanut butter.

Stir one teaspoon of smooth peanut butter into three tablespoons of yogurt, or into fruit purée, until it is loose. The yogurt path contains milk and the fruit path is milk-free.
